title: Find the IDs of male patients who were admitted to the hospital, have abnor
question: Find the IDs of male patients who were admitted to the hospital, have abnormal uric acid levels (≤8.0), and also exhibit either an abnormal lactate dehydrogenase level (≥500) or a creatinine level outside the normal range (≥1.5). Among these, return only those whose first hospital visit occurred before any of their laboratory tests with such abnormalities.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p."XCL_058"
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p."XCL_058" = e."XCL_001"
WHERE p."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND e."XCL_013" > 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."XCL_014" = p."XCL_058"
      AND l."XCL_022" <= 8.0
      AND (l."XCL_018" >= 500 OR CAST(l."XCL_056" AS REAL) >= 1.5)
      AND e."XCL_002" < l."XCL_015"
  )
